peopleAlsoAsk.question: What is the thermal degradation of sodium alginate?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: The major degradation of Na-alginate occurred in second temperature interval from 180 to 500oC (weight loss of about 50%) where loss of volatile components, rupture of chains and fragmentation of sodium alginate occurs. This process is followed with two exothermic peaks at DTA curve with maximums at 240 and 348oC.
